scripts.generate:sdk: python scripts/export_openapi.py && pnpm --dir frontend --filter @astrophotoflow/ui exec openapi-ts -f openapi-ts.config.ts
scripts.build: python scripts/build_engine.py && pnpm typecheck && pnpm --dir frontend build
scripts.check:boundaries: python -m pytest tests/architecture -q && pnpm --dir frontend exec depcruise src/platform/astrophotoflow packages/astrophotoflow-ui/src --config .dependency-cruiser.json --do-not-follow "node_modules|^src/(?!platform/astrophotoflow/)" --output-type err-long
